items.exampleZh: 走路是我日常生活的一部分。

items.audioEn: My daily schedule is simple: work in the morning and English class at night.
items.audioZh: 我每天的行程很簡單：早上工作，晚上上英文課。
options: Goes to work at the office

items.sentenceEn: His English is gradually getting better.

items.stemZh: 因為下大雨，延誤了兩個小時。

items.stemEn: She checks her email ____, about five times a day.
items.stemZh: 她經常收電子郵件，一天大約五次。

items.passageEn: Leo works in a busy office. His schedule is always full, and he often stays late. He had no time for exercise, so one day he had a sudden idea: he would walk to work. At first it was hard, but gradually he started to enjoy it. Now he walks daily, and he feels much better. "I will do this forever," he says.
items.passageZh: Leo 在一間很忙的公司上班。他的行程總是排得滿滿的，也常常加班到很晚。他以前完全沒時間運動，所以有一天他突然想到一個主意：走路上班。一開始很辛苦，但他漸漸開始喜歡上走路。現在他每天都走路，覺得身體好多了。他說：「我要永遠這樣走下去。」

questions.questionZh: Leo 突然想到什麼主意？

referenceEn: My schedule is very full this week.
I have a very busy schedule this week.
rubricZh: 「行程」用 schedule（例如 my schedule、a busy schedule）
「很滿」可寫例如 very full、very busy

items.instructionZh: 用 daily 造一個句子，說說你每天都會做的一件事。
referenceEn: I drink a glass of milk daily.
rubricZh: daily 可放在名詞前（例如 my daily life），也可放在句尾當「每天」（例如 I walk daily）
說每天的習慣用現在式（例如 drink、walk）
